tools.name: get_filings
tools.description: Latest parsed SEC filings. Filter by kind (8-K, insider, stake, ipo, flag), ticker and day.

tools.name: get_insider_trades
tools.description: Insider (Form 4) buys and sells. Use buys_only and min_value to find meaningful open-market purchases; cluster_only for several insiders buying together. Set from_date/to_date to search history back to 2020 (trial keys: last 90 days).

tools.name: get_transactions
tools.description: Business plan. Every Form 4/5 transaction line back to 2006: all codes (P buy, S sale, A grant, M option exercise, F tax withholding, G gift...), derivative and non-derivative. from_date is required.

tools.name: get_company_filings
tools.description: A company's name, industry, exchanges and its latest filings.

tools.name: get_summaries
tools.description: Newest verified plain-English filing summaries, optionally for one ticker.

tools.name: get_summary
tools.description: One verified summary by SEC accession number (e.g. 0001234567-26-000123).

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: This key's plan, calls used today and limits.
